articles.titleCn: 地板、天花板与融合差距：机器能预测多少人群阅读注意力？
articles.abstractCn: 基准分数若不了解一个简单方法能达到什么程度，以及最佳可能方法能达到什么程度，则毫无意义。我们针对一个具有稀有类型真实数据的任务构建了上下界：预测一群读者——为了各自目的、无偿、未受指导且互不知晓——在120份网络文档中标记的句子。下界是简单的截断（lead）；上界是分半预言机：一半人群预测另一半人群。它们之间的差距是+0.2028 AP [+0.1698, +0.2342, 领域聚类]，由三个发现构建。首先，差距是语义性的：位置和长度特征能恢复5%的差距。其次，前沿语言模型零样本能达到35-53%的差距——远超经典基线，远低于人群；最先进的提示压缩器（LLMLingua-2）低于下界，与随机选择无异。第三，五个前沿排名的无权重跨厂商融合加上位置先验能达到60%，超过最佳单一模型+0.0159 [+0.0044, +0.0269；Holm p=0.019]——这一提升在移除其最佳成员（分半臂选择）、提示释义、标签、门控和种子扰动后依然存在，并通过在217份独立文档上的预先注册复制实验得到证实（+0.0179，Holm p=0.042）。最后，括号压缩：将融合蒸馏成一个开放权重8B学生模型，该模型阅读整个文档，保留了融合90%的优势，并达到最强单一前沿模型的统计均势（+0.0070 [-0.0068, +0.0200]），而局部上下文学生仅保留63%——人群的信号存在于文档级结构中，已知最便宜的改进方法是让多个不同模型进行平均。

articles.title: Progressive Agent Skill Generation via Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Existing skill generation methods largely rely on heuristics or pipeline-style consolidation, which must be specially designed for different evidence sources. In contrast, learning-based approaches offer a more unified way to model skill generation across heterogeneous sources. However, learning-based skill generation remains challenging because skills lack a natural supervision signal based on relevance or correctness; their value can largely be determined only by whether they improve the behavior of the agent on downstream tasks. To address this challenge, we propose Skill-$α$, a reinforcement learning method for progressively generating high-quality agent skills. Specifically, we formulate skill generation as a sequential editing process that decomposes skill construction into individually evaluable edits, and introduce a novel rollback reward that evaluates each edit by comparing downstream execution under the original and edited skills on an anchored query. Extensive experiments show that Skill-$α$ generates more effective skills than methods based on heuristics or pipelines in both document-to-skill and experience-to-skill settings. Under the main GPT-4o worker, Skill-$α$ improves average downstream success rates over the strongest skill-generation baseline by 3.3 points on CL-Bench and 6.7 points on tau2-bench. Further ablations validate the importance of rollback reward and progressive generation.
articles.titleCn: 基于强化学习的渐进式代理技能生成
articles.abstractCn: 现有的技能生成方法主要依赖于启发式方法或管道式整合，这些方法必须针对不同的证据来源进行专门设计。相比之下，基于学习的方法提供了一种更统一的方式来对异构来源中的技能生成进行建模。然而，基于学习的技能生成仍然具有挑战性，因为技能缺乏基于相关性或正确性的自然监督信号；它们的价值在很大程度上只能通过是否能够提升代理在下游任务中的行为来决定。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了Skill-$α$，这是一种用于逐步生成高质量代理技能的强化学习方法。具体而言，我们将技能生成表述为一个顺序编辑过程，将技能构建分解为可单独评估的编辑，并引入了一种新的回滚奖励机制，通过比较原始技能和编辑后技能在锚定查询上的下游执行来评估每个编辑。大量实验表明，Skill-$α$在文档到技能和经验到技能的设置下都比基于启发式或管道的方法生成更有效的技能。在主要的GPT-4o工作节点上，Skill-$α$在CL-Bench上比最强的技能生成基线平均提升了3.3个百分点，在tau2-bench上提升了6.7个百分点。进一步的消融实验验证了回滚奖励和逐步生成的重要性。

articles.title: Understanding Sparse Attention Selectivity in Long-Context Foundation Models via Counterfactual Evaluation
articles.abstract: Sparse attention is widely deployed in long-context serving stacks, yet no framework audits how discarding blocks changes the influence of specific content on model output. We first establish that the phenomenon is real and causal: Block Sparse Flash Attention (BSFA) route replay across four architectures changes output decisions in 13 of 16 cells, with zero identity-replay label flips. We then introduce a dense-calibrated counterfactual audit using matched probe cards---Gold (carrying the correct answer label), Poison (carrying a target wrong label), and Benign (filler only)---under six-layout position symmetry, isolating the sparsification-specific effect. Two patterns compete. Signal concentration: the selector preserves Gold and Poison blocks far above filler-matched Benign blocks (G$\approx$P$\gg$B across all model--task pairs). Integration loss: discarding blocks severs cross-block attention---confirmed by an ablation where isolating the probe block collapses its influence from 4.48 logits to zero. Compression ratio governs the balance: a full sweep from mild ($c=0.25$) to aggressive ($c=0.75$) compression across four model--task pairs reveals that three of four cells move toward stronger sparse amplification at higher compression, with two exhibiting sign reversals. Three independent arms---BSFA route replay, controlled block-top-$k$, and KV-cache eviction---converge: sparsification changes content influence in ways aggregate accuracy cannot detect. We provide an open measurement framework deployable on any model exposing block identities.
articles.titleCn: 通过反事实评估理解长上下文基础模型中的稀疏注意力选择性
articles.abstractCn: 稀疏注意力机制在长上下文服务栈中被广泛应用，但尚无框架审计丢弃某些区块如何改变特定内容对模型输出的影响。我们首先证实该现象确实存在且具有因果关系：区块稀疏Flash Attention（BSFA）在不同架构中的路由重放改变了16个单元中的13个输出决策，且无身份重放标签翻转。随后，我们引入了基于匹配探针卡的密集校准反事实审计——包括携带正确答案标签的黄金卡、携带目标错误标签的毒药卡以及仅填充的良性卡——在六种布局位置对称下，隔离稀疏化特有的效应。两种模式相互竞争：信号集中模式：选择器显著保留黄金卡和毒药卡，远超填充匹配的良性卡（G≈P>>B适用于所有模型-任务对）；整合损失模式：丢弃区块会切断跨区块注意力——通过消融实验验证，隔离探针区块的影响力从4.48 logits降至零。压缩率调控平衡：在四个模型-任务对中从温和（c=0.25）到激进（c=0.75）的完整压缩扫描显示，四分之三的单元在更高压缩率下向更强的稀疏放大移动，其中两例出现符号反转。三个独立分支——BSFA路由重放、受控区块top-k和KV缓存驱逐——结果趋同：稀疏化改变了内容影响力，这种变化无法被综合准确率检测。我们提供了一种开放测量框架，可部署于任何暴露区块身份的模型。

articles.title: Learning What to Remember: Test-Time Training via Context Distillation
articles.abstract: Effective long-context modeling is not merely about retaining more of the past, but about preserving the information that may prove relevant later. Test-time training (TTT) is an appealing approach that performs online parameter updates for long-context modeling, yet existing TTT methods only optimize either reconstruction or online adaptation objectives without considering the future utility of retained information. In this work, we propose \textbf{T}est-\textbf{T}ime \textbf{C}ontext \textbf{D}istillation (TTCD), a TTT framework that introduces a self-supervised objective for allocating limited memory capacity for future use. Specifically, TTCD uses a long-window teacher to supervise the fast weights of a short-window student, where the hidden-state discrepancy between them offers a dense, self-supervised signal guiding the model to memorize the contextual information crucial for future token predictions. We focus on an in-place variant: In-Place TTCD (IP-TTCD), which uses the existing MLP parameters as the fast weights. Experiments on long-context language modeling tasks show IP-TTCD consistently outperforms DeltaNet, Gated DeltaNet, sliding-window attention, and TTT when pre-trained from scratch. Furthermore, IP-TTCD allows pre-trained transformer models to adapt their parameters during inference through continual pre-training, gaining long-context capabilities with only a lightweight architectural augmentation. Our results position TTCD as a step toward architectural continual learning.
articles.titleCn: 学习要记住什么：通过上下文蒸馏进行测试时训练
articles.abstractCn: 有效的长上下文建模不仅在于保留更多过去信息，更在于保存那些未来可能相关的信息。测试时训练（TTT）是一种对长上下文建模具有吸引力的方法，它通过在线参数更新实现，但现有的TTT方法仅优化重建或在线适应目标，而未考虑保留信息的未来效用。在这项工作中，我们提出了\textbf{T}est-\textbf{T}ime \textbf{C}ontext \textbf{D}istillation（TTCD），一种引入自监督目标的TTT框架，用于分配有限的内存容量以供未来使用。具体而言，TTCD使用一个长窗口教师模型来监督一个短窗口学生模型的快速权重，它们之间的隐藏状态差异提供了一个密集的自监督信号，引导模型记忆对未来令牌预测至关重要的上下文信息。我们关注一种原位变体：原位TTCD（IP-TTCD），它使用现有的MLP参数作为快速权重。在长上下文语言建模任务上的实验表明，IP-TTCD始终优于DeltaNet、Gated DeltaNet、滑动窗口注意力和TTT（从头开始预训练时）。此外，IP-TTCD允许预训练的Transformer模型通过持续预训练在推理过程中调整其参数，仅通过轻量级架构增强即可获得长上下文能力。我们的结果将TTCD定位为架构持续学习的一步。

articles.title: Style Wins, Substance Loses: A Diagnosis of LLM-as-Judge in Idea Generation
articles.abstract: However, whether these judges truly evaluate the scientific substance of ideas or are influenced by superficial stylistic presentation remains an open question. To address this question, we propose SciStyleBench, a unified three-component benchmark for diagnosing and mitigating stylistic bias in LLM-based idea evaluation: (i) First, SciStyleStage, a three-stage evaluation environment that applies controlled stylistic perturbations to fixed scientific content across three settings no context, fixed-domain context, and open-domain retrieval context, covering 600 scientific ideas and 15 style variants, with 9,000 evaluation instances per setting; (ii) Second, SciStyleMetrics, a set of quantitative measures, including Style Bias Index (SBI), Substance Recognition Rate (SRR), and Adversarial Win Rate (AWR), to characterize how stylistic variation affects scoring stability, substance discrimination, and ranking robustness; (iii) Third, SciStyleExtractor, a plug-and-play evaluation module that separates presentation style from scientific content by predicting style type and deviation before style-conditioned evaluation, enabling us to assess whether style awareness reduces stylistic bias. Experiments on SciStyleBench show that direct LLM judges remain sensitive to writing style and struggle to distinguish scientific substance. In contrast, SciStyleExtractor reduces SBI from 0.566 to 0.501 while increasing SRR and AWR from 0.504 and 0.554 to 0.759 and 0.899, respectively. These results suggest that robust idea evaluation requires invariance to stylistic variation without sacrificing sensitivity to scientific substance. Overall, SciStyleBench provides a systematic framework for identifying, quantifying, and mitigating stylistic bias in scientific idea evaluation.

articles.titleCn: 风格胜于内容：对作为评判者的LLM在创意生成中的诊断
articles.abstractCn: 然而，这些评委是否真正评估了想法的科学实质，还是受到了表面风格呈现的影响，仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。为了解答这个问题，我们提出了SciStyleBench，一个用于诊断和减轻基于LLM的想法评估中风格偏见的统一三组件基准：(i) 首先，SciStyleStage，一个三阶段评估环境，在三种设置（无上下文、固定领域上下文和开放领域检索上下文）中对固定的科学内容应用受控的风格扰动，涵盖600个科学想法和15种风格变体，每个设置包含9,000个评估实例；(ii) 其次，SciStyleMetrics，一套定量指标，包括风格偏差指数（SBI）、实质识别率（SRR）和对抗胜率（AWR），用于表征风格变化如何影响评分稳定性、实质区分和排名鲁棒性；(iii) 第三，SciStyleExtractor，一个即插即用的评估模块，通过在风格条件评估前预测风格类型和偏差，将呈现风格与科学内容分离，使我们能够评估风格意识是否减少了风格偏见。在SciStyleBench上的实验表明，直接的LLM评委仍然对写作风格敏感，难以区分科学实质。相比之下，SciStyleExtractor将SBI从0.566降低到0.501，同时将SRR和AWR分别从0.504和0.554提高到0.759和0.899。这些结果表明，稳健的想法评估需要在不受风格变化影响的同时，保持对科学实质的敏感性。总体而言，SciStyleBench提供了一个系统框架，用于识别、量化并减轻科学想法评估中的风格偏见。

articles.title: LongCat Sparse Attention: Taming the Lightning via Streaming-aware Hierarchical Cross-Layer Indexing
articles.abstract: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) enables efficient long-context modeling through its Lightning Indexer. However, practical deployment remains constrained by the indexer's expensive $O(L^2)$ scoring overhead and the hardware-inefficient, discontinuous memory-access patterns induced by its outputs. To address these system-level bottlenecks, we introduce LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA), a hardware-algorithm co-designed framework comprising three complementary and orthogonal strategies: (1) Streaming-Aware Indexing, which selectively converts scattered KV entries into hardware-aligned contiguous layouts to enable coalesced HBM access; (2) Cross-Layer Indexing, which amortizes indexing overhead by reusing the results produced by a single layer across consecutive layers, supported by cross-layer distillation; and (3) Hierarchical Indexing, which adopts a coarse-to-fine scoring scheme to progressively narrow the candidate set for each query, thereby substantially reducing indexing computation. Extensive scaling experiments, ranging from 69B-A3B to 560B-A27B models, demonstrate that LSA consistently achieves performance on par with full attention across both general-purpose and long-context benchmarks. Moreover, LSA supports native training with context lengths of up to one million tokens and underpins the development of LongCat-2.0 (1.6T-A48B). To facilitate further research, we also introduce and open-source LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse (69B-A3B), which integrates LSA into LongCat-Flash-Lite and incorporates an updated long-context training corpus.
articles.titleCn: 长猫稀疏注意力：通过流感知分层跨层索引驯服闪电
articles.abstractCn: 深度搜索稀疏注意力（DSA）通过其闪电索引器实现了高效的上下文建模。然而，实际部署仍然受限于索引器昂贵的$O(L^2)$评分开销，以及其输出所引发的硬件低效、不连续的内存访问模式。为解决这些系统级瓶颈，我们引入了长猫稀疏注意力（LSA），这是一个硬件-算法协同设计的框架，包含三种互补且正交的策略：(1) 流式感知索引，通过选择性地将分散的KV条目转换为硬件对齐的连续布局，以实现合并式HBM访问；(2) 跨层索引，通过重用单层产生的结果来分摊索引开销，并由跨层蒸馏支持；(3) 分层索引，采用由粗到细的评分方案来逐步缩小每个查询的候选集，从而大幅减少索引计算。广泛的扩展实验，范围从69B-A3B到560B-A27B模型，证明LSA在通用和长上下文基准测试中始终能达到全注意力相当的性能。此外，LSA支持高达一百万个token的上下文长度的原生训练，并支撑了长猫-2.0（1.6T-A48B）的开发。为促进进一步研究，我们还引入并开源了长猫-闪电-轻量-稀疏（69B-A3B），该框架集成了LSA到长猫-闪电-轻量，并包含更新的长上下文训练语料库。

articles.title: Bole: Efficient Tree Speculation for Hybrid-Attention Language Models
articles.abstract: Hybrid-attention large language models combine full attention with recurrent linear attention to reduce long-context inference costs, yet their autoregressive decoding remains memory-bound. Tree speculative decoding offers an attractive acceleration path, but existing tree-speculation systems are designed around the key--value caches of full-attention models. On hybrid models, they traverse recurrent layers branch by branch and materialize a full state for every proposal node, causing verification latency and transient memory to scale poorly with tree and batch sizes. We present Bole, a kernel--runtime co-design that enables efficient tree speculation for hybrid-attention LLMs. Bole transforms the linear-attention recurrence into a tree-structured closed form and realizes it with a resource-efficient GPU kernel, verifying all proposal nodes in parallel and accelerating linear-attention tree verification by 3.4--7.7$\times$. It losslessly encodes speculative state updates as token-level factors and reconstructs only the state selected after sampling, reducing transient state memory by 82--99$\times$ and freeing GPU capacity for KV caches. Its integration into SGLang, a widely deployed production LLM serving engine, couples efficient state management with a batch-wide verification budget calibrated to the complete hybrid forward. Across four models, two GPU platforms, and diverse datasets, Bole delivers up to $4.72\times$ the offline decode throughput of autoregressive decoding and up to $2.03\times$ that of the strongest tree-speculative baseline. Under online agent workloads, it reduces TTFT and TPOT by up to $67.6%$ and $49.9%$, respectively, over the strongest tree-speculative baseline.
articles.titleCn: 博莱：混合注意力语言模型的树形推测优化
articles.abstractCn: 混合注意力大型语言模型结合了全注意力机制和循环线性注意力机制来降低长上下文推理成本，但其自回归解码仍然受内存限制。树形推测解码提供了一条有吸引力的加速路径，但现有的树形推测系统都是围绕全注意力模型的关键-值缓存设计的。在混合模型中，它们逐层遍历循环层，为每个提议节点生成完整状态，导致验证延迟和临时内存随着树形和批次规模的增长而表现不佳。我们提出了Bole，这是一种内核-运行时协同设计，能够为混合注意力LLM实现高效的树形推测。Bole将线性注意力递归转换为树形结构的封闭形式，并使用资源高效的GPU内核实现，并行验证所有提议节点，并将线性注意力树形验证加速3.4-7.7倍。它无损地编码推测状态更新为标记级因子，并仅重建采样后选择的状态，将临时状态内存减少82-99倍，并释放GPU用于KV缓存的能力。将其集成到SGLang（一种广泛部署的生产LLM服务引擎）中，将高效的状态管理与针对完整混合前向的批次级验证预算相结合。在四个模型、两个GPU平台和多样化数据集上，Bole实现了自回归解码离线解码吞吐量的最高4.72倍，以及最强树形推测基线的最高2.03倍。在在线代理工作负载下，它将TTFT和TPOT分别比最强树形推测基线降低了高达67.6%和49.9%。

articles.title: Does Accuracy Equal Evidence? Reasoning Faithfulness under KV Cache Compression
articles.abstract: KV cache compression is commonly evaluated by final-answer accuracy, implicitly assuming that preserving the answer also preserves the reasoning that supports it. We test this assumption for large reasoning models and show that it can fail: under compression, correct answers and the validity of their visible supporting rationales can be preserved at different rates. We study this failure with a controlled fixed-trace replay protocol, which holds reasoning content fixed and isolates whether compression preserves usable information from an already available trace. We evaluate ten token-eviction KV compression methods and one quantization method on three models across mathematical reasoning, scientific QA, clinical calculation, and long-context retrieval. We measure final accuracy, answer-chain consistency, and perturbation faithfulness. Across tasks, token-eviction methods can preserve competitive final-answer accuracy while substantially degrading chain support or perturbation faithfulness. We call this the answer-evidence gap. A coverage-preserving quantization control is substantially less affected, suggesting that the failure is tied less to KV memory reduction itself than to losing access to parts of the reasoning trace. Code is available at https://github.com/famous-blue-raincoat/Safe_KV_Compress.
articles.titleCn: 准确等于证据吗？KV缓存压缩下的推理忠实性
articles.abstractCn: KV缓存压缩通常通过最终答案的准确率来评估，隐含地假设保留答案也意味着保留了支持答案的推理过程。我们针对大型推理模型测试了这一假设，并证明其可能失效：在压缩情况下，正确答案及其可见支持性推理的保真度可能以不同的速率被保留。我们通过一个控制固定的推理轨迹重放协议研究这种失效，该协议保持推理内容固定，并隔离压缩是否能在已有的轨迹中保留可用信息。我们在数学推理、科学问答、临床计算和长上下文检索三个模型上评估了十种token驱逐KV压缩方法和一种量化方法。我们测量了最终准确率、答案链一致性和扰动保真度。在各项任务中，token驱逐方法可以保留有竞争力的最终答案准确率，但会显著降低链支持或扰动保真度。我们称之为“答案-证据差距”。一种保留覆盖率的量化控制受影响较小，表明这种失效与KV内存减少本身的关系较小，而更多地与失去对推理轨迹部分信息的访问有关。代码可在https://github.com/famous-blue-raincoat/Safe_KV_Compress获取。

articles.title: RING: Retrieval-Internalized Generation for Continual Large-Scale Knowledge Injection
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves factuality but adds latency and engineering overhead at serving time. We propose RING (Retrieval-Internalized Generation), a holistic paradigm spanning both architecture and training that injects large-scale external knowledge into a \textit{Mixture-of-Memory Experts} and learns parametric search over this internal memory via reinforcement learning, removing the external retriever entirely. Training proceeds in three stages: continued pre-training injects new corpora into a Knowledge Expert via our novel \textit{Dual Causal Attention}; supervised fine-tuning teaches a ``search-then-answer'' pattern; and reinforcement learning with hierarchical rewards optimizes the routing-and-search policy over the parametric memory. Unlike prior parametric injection methods that pair internal memory with a fixed or rule-based retriever, RING {learns} its retrieval policy directly from task signals. We further frame RING theoretically as a search-free approximation to the classical RAG objective. To evaluate large-scale injection of genuinely {new} knowledge without test-time leakage, we further construct News-2025, a benchmark built from news strictly post-dating the base LLM's pretraining cutoff. RING matches or surpasses both search-based RAG and parametric injection baselines in accuracy and efficiency.
articles.titleCn: RING：持续大规模知识注入的检索-内化生成方法
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）提升了事实准确性，但在服务时增加了延迟和工程开销。我们提出了 RING（内化检索生成），这是一个涵盖架构和训练的整体范式，将大规模外部知识注入到“记忆专家混合体”中，并通过强化学习学习对内部记忆的参数化搜索，从而完全移除了外部检索器。训练分为三个阶段：持续预训练通过我们创新的“双因果注意力”将新语料库注入知识专家；监督微调教授“先搜索后回答”的模式；强化学习结合分层奖励优化参数化记忆中的路由和搜索策略。与以往将内部记忆与固定或基于规则的检索器配对进行参数化注入的方法不同，RING 直接从任务信号中学习其检索策略。我们进一步从理论上将 RING 框架化为对经典 RAG 目标的无搜索近似。为了评估大规模注入真正新知识而不存在测试时泄露的情况，我们进一步构建了 News-2025，这是一个基于严格在基础 LLM 预训练截止日期之后发布的新闻构建的基准。RING 在准确性和效率方面均与基于搜索的 RAG 和参数化注入基线相匹配或超越。

articles.title: Human-LLM Alignment in Language Attitudes Toward Non-Native Japanese
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly evaluate human writing in high-stakes domains such as hiring and academic assessment, putting non-native speakers at particular risk. Drawing on the language attitudes framework, we compared human and LLM evaluations of parallel L1- and L2-written Japanese emails on three dimensions: fluency, status, and solidarity. Japanese raters rated L2 texts significantly lower on all three dimensions, with a fluency gap roughly twice the size of the status and solidarity gaps. Six LLM judges reproduced the direction of this bias, and five reproduced its ordering across dimensions. The models diverged from humans in two ways: all understated the solidarity gap, the most socially grounded dimension, and all differentiated among learner L1 backgrounds where humans did not. LLM judges thus reproduce native speakers' language attitudes in a structured yet attenuated form, and the language attitudes framework offers a ready-made yardstick for auditing them beyond English.
articles.titleCn: 非母语日语使用者对非母语日语的态度中的人-LLM对齐
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地评估招聘和学术评估等高风险领域的人类写作，使非母语者面临特别的风险。基于语言态度框架，我们比较了人类和LLM对平行的一语和二语日语电子邮件在流畅性、地位和团结性三个维度的评价。日语评价者在一语文本的所有三个维度上显著降低了二语文本的评分，流畅性差距大约是地位和团结性差距的两倍。六位LLM评价者复制了这种偏见的方向，五位复制了维度排序。模型在两个方面与人类存在差异：所有模型都低估了最具社会基础维度的团结性差距，并且所有模型都在人类没有区分的学习者一语背景中进行了区分。因此，LLM评价者以结构化但减弱的形式复制了母语者的语言态度，而语言态度框架为审计英语以外的语言态度提供了一个现成的标准。

articles.title: Not the Dimension, the Norm: What Matters in Gradient-Free Weight Perturbation of Language Models
articles.abstract: Adapting a language model to a task no longer requires training all of its weights, and a line of parameter-efficient methods has driven the trainable count from billions down to a handful of scalars. Gradient-free adaptation, which samples random weight perturbations and keeps the ones that score well, has not followed that trajectory and still perturbs every entry of the weight tensor. It is unknown whether that full-weight search is necessary, and more fundamentally which property of a perturbation makes it work at all, because existing methods vary the search space, the perturbation scale, and the aggregation together. We resolve this by intervening on one factor at a time inside a fixed pipeline, holding candidate scoring and voting constant while we vary the search dimension, the subspace that carries the perturbation, and its norm. Perturbing a frozen frame of 12 to 16 scalars stays 1.8 accuracy points behind full-weight search on average across 49 model-benchmark cells, trailing it in 36 of them. Neither the dimension nor the choice of basis explains that performance. A random frame whose Grassmann overlap with the SVD frame is at chance level performs identically once a single scale factor is matched, and at large scales the SVD directions collapse first. What survives is the perturbation norm, whose usable range closes within a factor of five across seven models and stays flat inside. The perturbation norm is therefore the one factor with a failure mode, and its safe region transfers across scale and family. The design question narrows from which subspace to perturb to how hard to shake.
articles.titleCn: 不是维度，而是范数：梯度无关权重扰动中语言模型的关键因素
articles.abstractCn: 将语言模型适配于特定任务不再需要训练其所有权重，一系列参数高效的参数调整方法将可训练参数数量从数十亿减少到几个标量。无梯度适配方法通过随机扰动权重并保留得分较高的权重，并未遵循这一趋势，仍然扰动权重张量的每个元素。尚不清楚是否需要进行全权重搜索，以及更根本的是，扰动的哪种属性使其发挥作用，因为现有方法在搜索空间、扰动规模和聚合方式上存在差异。我们通过在固定流程中逐个干预一个因素来解决这一问题，在候选评分和投票保持不变的情况下，改变搜索维度（即携带扰动的子空间）及其范数。对12到16个标量的冻结帧进行扰动，在49个模型基准单元中平均落后全权重搜索1.8个准确率点，在36个单元中表现更差。维度或基选择都无法解释这一性能差异。当随机帧与SVD帧的格拉斯曼重叠处于随机水平时，一旦匹配单个尺度因子，其表现与随机帧相同，并且在大尺度下SVD方向首先坍缩。留存的是扰动范数，其可用范围在七个模型中缩小了五个倍数，并在内部保持稳定。因此，扰动范数是唯一存在失效模式的因素，其安全区域可以跨越不同尺度和模型家族。设计问题从“扰动哪个子空间”缩小到“如何扰动”。

articles.title: PICTURE: Enhancing Theory-of-Mind in Large Language Models by Revealing, Not Hiding, Characters' Lack of Knowledge
articles.abstract: Simulating human-like Theory of Mind (ToM) has been a longstanding problem in natural language processing (NLP). To address this, existing works introduce a reasoning step of event hiding (a.k.a. perspective-taking), where events unknown to a character are removed before question answering. However, resorting to event hiding for ToM reasoning presents a performance degradation issue due to the strict output format constraints involved in event hiding. To mitigate this issue, we propose generating perspective-taking outputs as free-form explanations without event hiding, but this poses a notable yet underexplored challenge: LLMs need to inhibit responses to events unknown to characters, because the absence of event hiding exposes LLMs to these events throughout reasoning. To address this challenge, we hypothesize and empirically verify that LLMs can achieve such inhibition if a character's lack of knowledge about events is made explicit during reasoning. Based on this finding, we introduce PICTURE, a new prompting method that enables LLMs to generate a character's lack of knowledge within free-form Chain-of-Thought (CoT). Experimental results show that PICTURE outperforms existing prompting methods by an average of 7.3% on false-belief tasks.
articles.titleCn: 图片：通过揭示而非隐藏角色缺乏知识来增强大型语言模型中的心智理论
articles.abstractCn: 在自然语言处理（NLP）领域，模拟人类心智理论（Theory of Mind, ToM）一直是一个长期存在的难题。为了解决这个问题，现有研究引入了事件隐藏（也称为视角转换）的推理步骤，在回答问题之前移除角色未知的事件。然而，采用事件隐藏进行心智理论推理会因事件隐藏中严格的输出格式约束而导致性能下降问题。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出生成自由形式的解释性视角转换输出，而不进行事件隐藏，但这提出了一个显著但尚未充分探索的挑战：大型语言模型（LLMs）需要抑制对角色未知事件的回应，因为事件隐藏的缺失使LLMs在整个推理过程中暴露于这些事件。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出假设并通过实证验证，认为如果在进行推理时明确指出角色对事件的无知，LLMs就能实现这种抑制。基于这一发现，我们引入了PICTURE，这是一种新的提示方法，使LLMs能够在自由形式的思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）中生成角色对事件的无知。实验结果表明，PICTURE在错误信念任务上的平均表现优于现有提示方法7.3%。

articles.title: Semantic Alignment of AI Models: Concept Collapse, Checkpoint Dynamics, and Cross-Lingual Transfer
articles.abstract: Language model benchmarking is a difficult task. Outcome reasoning alone does not test the model's conceptualization of language and popular open-source benchmarks are quickly saturated or ingested as training data. It is important to test the model's output, but augmenting these tests by characterizing semantic structure gives more insight to how models relate abstract concepts. However, the high dimensional embedding spaces are not easy to interpret. This work demonstrates how topological methods can be used to rigorously compare these spaces to low dimensional and interpretable baselines like ontologies and curated knowledge graphs. These multi-modal alignment tests make it possible to track model adaptations and test phrase understanding across multiple languages.
articles.titleCn: AI模型的语义对齐：概念坍塌、检查点动态和跨语言迁移
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型基准测试是一项艰巨的任务。仅通过结果推理无法测试模型对语言的概念化理解，而且流行的开源基准测试很快就会饱和或被用作训练数据。测试模型输出很重要，但通过描述语义结构来增强这些测试，可以更深入地了解模型如何关联抽象概念。然而，高维嵌入空间并不容易解释。这项工作展示了拓扑方法如何用于将这些空间与低维且可解释的基线（如本体和精选知识图谱）进行严格比较。这些多模态对齐测试使得追踪模型适应情况以及跨多种语言测试短语理解成为可能。

articles.title: Characterizing Treatment-Context Medication Evidence Across Clinic Notes and Structured EHR Medication History
articles.abstract: Clinic notes and structured electronic health record (EHR) medication history often contain different medication information. Same-visit disagreement between these sources may result from note-side normalization errors, differences in terminology or timing, or actual differences in documentation. We developed a note-grounded approach that uses large language model (LLM) assisted reference construction, targeted and random human review, deterministic medication normalization, and semantic and temporal comparisons with structured medication history. We evaluated all normalization results on a patient-level held-out test set to limit adaptation to the study cohort. On 5,403 held-out mention rows, exact canonical agreement improved from 0.7226 with surface-exact matching to 0.8429 after lexical cleanup and curated alias mapping. In a random audit of previously unaudited rows, canonical-label agreement was 0.9210 among evaluable valid medication mentions, whereas treatment-action attribution was lower at 0.5326. In the full-cohort characterization analysis, only 16.44% of note-derived rows had same-visit exact overlap with structured medication history, but 55.17% had same-visit semantic overlap, 90.34% had same-visit or +/-30-day overlap, and only 3.97% remained in the strict no-structured-overlap bucket under broad project-level mapping. An ontology-backed sensitivity analysis further showed that held-out strict Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership (OMOP)-backed no-overlap fell from 43.99% to 36.68% after a development-derived alias supplement. These results show that note-to-structured-medication mismatch can arise from normalization errors, differences in terminology, and differences in documentation timing.
articles.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to IEEE BIBM 2026
articles.titleCn: 在临床记录和结构化电子健康记录用药史中表征治疗背景下的用药证据
articles.abstractCn: 临床记录和结构化电子健康记录（EHR）用药史通常包含不同的药物信息。这些来源在相同就诊时的不一致可能源于记录端的标准化错误、术语或时间差异，或实际记录差异。我们开发了一种基于记录的方法，该方法使用大型语言模型（LLM）辅助的参考构建、目标和非目标人工审查、确定性药物标准化，以及与结构化用药史的语义和时间比较。我们在患者级别的保留测试集上评估了所有标准化结果，以限制对研究队列的适应。在5,403行保留提及中，精确规范一致性从表面精确匹配的0.7226提高到词汇清理和定制别名映射后的0.8429。在先前未审查行的随机审计中，可评估有效药物提及的规范标签一致性为0.9210，而治疗行为归因较低，为0.5326。在完整队列特征分析中，只有16.44%的记录行与结构化用药史有相同就诊的精确重叠，但55.17%有相同就诊的语义重叠，90.34%有相同就诊或±30天的重叠，在广泛的项目级映射下，只有3.97%仍处于严格无结构重叠的类别中。一个基于本体的敏感性分析进一步显示，保留的严格无重叠的Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership（OMOP）支持比例在开发衍生别名补充后从43.99%降至36.68%。这些结果表明，记录与结构化药物的不匹配可能源于标准化错误、术语差异和记录时间差异。

articles.title: DocNavRAG: Document-Structured Graph RAG with Stateful Evidence Construction for Complex Document Question Answering
articles.abstract: Answering complex questions over large document collections requires assembling complementary evidence across sections and documents. GraphRAG offers structured retrieval but typically uses fixed traversal, while agentic RAG operates over weakly structured interfaces. Our key insight is that agents should navigate document structure within and across documents rather than repeatedly search from scratch. We introduce DocNavRAG, which organizes document hierarchies and cross-region relations into a navigable graph, exposes graph operations for locating, navigating, expanding, and fetching, and maintains an evolving evidence state to guide retrieval until sufficient evidence is collected. Across four long- and multi-document QA benchmarks, DocNavRAG improves answer quality and context sufficiency over the strongest baseline by 7.8\% and 17.7\% on average.
articles.titleCn: DocNavRAG：面向复杂文档问答的文档结构化图RAG，具有状态证据构建功能
articles.abstractCn: 回答大型文档集合中的复杂问题需要跨章节和文档整合互补证据。GraphRAG提供结构化检索，但通常使用固定遍历，而智能体式RAG在弱结构化接口上运行。我们的关键洞察是智能体应导航文档内部及跨文档的结构，而不是重复从头开始搜索。我们引入了DocNavRAG，该系统将文档层次结构和跨区域关系组织成可导航的图，提供图操作以定位、导航、扩展和获取，并维护不断演变的证据状态以指导检索直至收集到足够的证据。在四个长文本和多文档问答基准测试中，DocNavRAG平均比最强基线在答案质量和上下文充分性上分别提高了7.8%和17.7%。

articles.title: Discriminative Axis, Not Data Volume: What a Contrastive Corpus Teaches an Audio Embedding
articles.abstract: Scaling the corpus is the default remedy when a contrastive representation lacks an attribute. We report a case where it does nothing, and identify what does: adding a lexical-speech round to a frozen-base multimodal embedding model raises zero-shot keyword spotting by 76 points while reducing speech-emotion recognition by 14. The loss is not a capacity limit: fine-tuning on 7,442 clips from a prosody-controlled corpus recovers emotion past its pre-speech level at a five-point keyword cost. Nor is it data volume: 29,428 mined clips whose captions explicitly name emotions, at matched exposure, move emotion by -0.0007. The difference is structural: a contrastive objective encodes an attribute only when the in-batch negatives cannot be separated without it; the controlled corpus holds sentence content fixed, so prosody is the only separating signal, whereas mined captions name emotion yet remain separable by scene content. Intervention on the same audio confirms causality: raising caption similarity does not recover emotion, but collapsing caption diversity so that emotion becomes the only separating axis recovers it by 8.9 points across three seeds, with a smaller, same-signed gain on a non-acted corpus, while keyword accuracy trades back. Corpus structure, not size or caption vocabulary, controls what a contrastive audio embedding encodes.
articles.titleCn: 区分性轴而非数据量：对比语料库向音频嵌入所揭示的启示
articles.abstractCn: 当对比式表征缺少某个属性时，扩展语料库是默认的解决方法。我们报告了一个案例，该方法毫无作用，并识别了真正有效的方法：在冻结基的多模态嵌入模型中添加一个词汇-语音循环，可将零样本关键词识别提升76个点，同时降低语音情绪识别14个点。损失并非能力限制：在来自韵律控制语料库的7,442个片段上进行微调，可将情绪恢复到其语音前水平，代价是5个点的关键词成本。也不是数据量：在匹配暴露条件下，29,428个挖掘的、标题明确标注情绪的片段，情绪变化仅为-0.0007。差异在于结构：对比式目标仅在无法在不依赖该属性的情况下分离批次内的负样本时才编码属性；受控语料库固定句子内容，因此韵律是唯一的区分信号，而挖掘的标题标注情绪但可通过场景内容分离。对同一音频的干预证实了因果关系：提高标题相似度无法恢复情绪，但压缩标题多样性，使情绪成为唯一的区分轴，可在三个种子上恢复8.9个点，在非表演语料库上获得较小且同号的增益，而关键词准确率则有所下降。语料库结构，而非大小或标题词汇表，决定了对比式音频嵌入编码的内容。

articles.title: Does the Competitive Component of Adversarial Self-Play Improve Legal Reasoning? A Controlled Negative Result
articles.abstract: Adversarial self-play is an appealing recipe for legal reasoning: have a student model draft an argument, have an adversary attack it, and reward the student when its argument survives the attack. We designed exactly such a training signal -- a verifiable "survival" reward in which both the student's cited authorities and the adversary's counter-authorities are checked by a citation verifier, so that survival is decided on verified grounds rather than rhetoric, and fabricated citations are automatically neutralized. We then asked a narrow but important question: does the competitive component itself -- the adversary and the survival reward -- add anything on top of an otherwise identical non-competitive training run? Across four independent tests -- a bootstrap comparison, a two-seed replication, a paired per-case adversarial-robustness comparison, and a blinded head-to-head judgment of generated arguments, plus a follow-up pilot with a deliberately strengthened self-play adversary -- the competitive component produced no reliable benefit. The blinded judgment gave a 49% win rate (binomial p approx. 1.000); the strengthened-adversary pilot gave a 50% win rate (32:32, p approx. 1.000). An early apparent +29% advantage reversed and proved to be a small-sample artifact. We report this as an honest negative result. The value of the paper is reproducibility and the sharing of concrete pitfalls: an initially promising metric that inverted on more data, and an adversarial-robustness metric that silently collapsed to plain recall once the adversary stopped citing the same authorities as the gold answer. This null is consistent with, and reconfirms in the legal domain, the conclusion of the companion coding-domain study (Kim, 2026, arXiv:2607.08255) that the value of multi-teacher curricula arises from constructing a verifiable environment rather than from competition itself.
articles.titleCn: 对抗性自我博弈的竞争成分是否提升了法律推理能力？一项受控的负面结果
articles.abstractCn: 对抗性自我博弈是一种引人入胜的法律推理训练方法：让学生模型起草论证，让对手攻击它，并在其论证经受住攻击时给予奖励。我们设计了一种精确的此类训练信号——一种可验证的“存活”奖励，其中学生模型引用的权威和对手的反驳权威均由引文验证器进行检查，从而确保存活是基于验证而非修辞，并自动消除伪造的引文。随后，我们提出了一个狭窄但重要的问题：竞争性组件本身——即对手和存活奖励——在与其他条件完全相同的非竞争性训练中是否还能带来额外收益？在四个独立测试中——自举比较、双种子复制、配对个案对抗鲁棒性比较、以及生成的论证的盲法头对头判断，外加一个故意加强的自我博弈对手的后续试点——竞争性组件并未产生可靠的优势。盲法判断给出了49%的胜率（二项式p值约1.000）；加强对手试点给出了50%的胜率（32:32，p值约1.000）。一个早期显现的+29%优势被逆转，并证明是小样本偏差。我们报告这一诚实负结果。该论文的价值在于可重复性和具体陷阱的分享：一个最初有前景的指标在更多数据中反转，以及一个对抗鲁棒性指标在对手停止引用与黄金答案相同的权威时无声地崩溃为普通召回。这一零结果与法律领域的结论一致，并再次确认了伴随的编码领域研究（Kim, 2026, arXiv:2607.08255）的结论，即多导师课程的价值源于构建可验证环境而非竞争本身。
